verses.1: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus, was sent by God’s will to those who are holy and faithful in Ephesus, as well as to those who believe in Christ Jesus.
verses.2: May grace and peace be with you from our God, our Father, and from Jesus Christ.
verses.3: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heaven through Christ.
verses.4: Since he chose us to be with him before the fall of the world, we must be holy and blameless before him in his love.
verses.5: You have called us to become children of God through Jesus Christ, in accordance with the will of His Father.
verses.6: to the praise of his grace, with which he has delighted us in that beloved place.
verses.7: In which we possess the power to remove those impurities through his blood. It is a way of eliminating all kinds of filth and impurities, according to the value of his grace.
verses.8: Who has brought us all this wisdom and guidance.
verses.9: Know our secret about his desire, according to the favor he was given.
verses.10: For the sake of managing the expenses during those times, everything should be put into Christ. Everything that belongs in heaven and everything that belongs on earth should be placed under His control. In Him alone.
verses.11: In which place also we were summoned, according to the plan of God, so that everything might function according to His will.
verses.12: That we may be worthy of His praise and glory among those who are prior in Christ.
verses.13: In whom, by listening to the word of truth and the gospel of salvation, you also believed. In whom, through faith, you were sealed by the Spirit of prophecy.
verses.14: This is the time of our inheritance, a time for celebration and thanksgiving for His glory.
verses.15: Therefore, I say that, after hearing the faith that you have in Lord Jesus, and the love he has for all the holy ones,
verses.16: I will not cease to thank you, so that your memory may be remembered in my prayers.
verses.17: That the Lord of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give you the breath of wisdom and revelation in your understanding of Him.
verses.18: May the eyes of your hearts be enlightened, so that you may know who his hope is, who his wealth of glory and inheritance among the saints is.
verses.19: And what is the excessive size of its power towards us, those who believe in its actions and its strength?
verses.20: What was created in Christ, that raised him from the dead? And he sat at his right hand in heaven.
verses.21: It surpasses all principles, powers, and authorities; it is a name that applies not only to this present age, but also to the future.
verses.22: And he commanded everything through his feet. He also placed his head above all the congregation.
verses.23: What constitutes his “body” is that it encompasses everything that exists in all things.
